ValidationRule.description: Delivered late shipments require a delay reason (US-0000517).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Delivered'), NOT(ISBLANK(Actual_Delivery_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Expected_Delivery_Date__c)), Actual_Delivery_Date__c > Expected_Delivery_Date__c, ISPICKVAL(Delay_Reason__c,''))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Delay Reason is required when a shipment is delivered late.
